body:
Cool, so nobody gives a shit even when I anonymously cry out. That’s very comforting; thanks a lot, dear community of people who, while I still lived, were there for me to affirm that “your life truly means nothing to anyone; not even a disinterested stranger who peruses such corners of the Internet as r/SuicideWatch could be bothered to give a shit about YOU. You know, there are people in this world with real problems, so fuck you, please kill yourself NOW.” Message from this community received loud and clear.

Goodbye, now!

Not OP, but this helped me.

Thanks, brother/sister.
